text:
Nobody:
Me at 2 AM reading a 40-page Wikipedia page on the history of paperclips:

POV: you bought a pull up bar
and now it is just a very expensive clothes hanger

me walking into airport security
with a water bottle
in my bag
from three days ago

Expectation: building a workshop to restore vintage motorcycles
Reality: spending 48 hours modifying a plastic box to store cables

Me after ordering one small item online
and tracking the delivery plane like I am air traffic control

setting five alarms five minutes apart

just to negotiate with myself five separate times

When a hatchback with the sun's actual nuclear core strapped to the front
is right behind you at a red light

Checking in for a domestic flight online
and the seating chart looks like a NASA launch protocol
for a puddle jumper to Cleveland

standing outside at 3am waiting for a meteor shower
and it is just one grey cloud
looking at me like an idiot

When the game asks you to choose
between helping the village or the hero
and you just stand in the woods
for three hours hoarding cheese

Examining a single blurry pixel in a new trailer
like a medieval monk
deciphering the holy text

Expectation: boarding the holiday flight smoothly
Reality: watching a pigeon slowly outwalk your aircraft

Me explaining to my cat
why I am cancelling the gym
after leaving the bag
next to the door for three days

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me deleting an app to save space
and instantly redownloading it
because I need it once

POV: pausing a movie to check the cast list
and ending up reading an obscure 2011 wiki page
about someone's guest appearance

me watching the one appliance
I own from the 1970s
still running smoothly
while my phone dies in a breeze

Expectation: organizing your entire phone
Reality: making a folder called stuff and never opening it

me leaving twenty minutes early
to beat the morning rush
and immediately joining a parking lot
made of five lanes of concrete

Nobody:

Me trying to look at a celebrity couple's blurry photo:
Enhance. Enhance. That is a tree branch.

Things that hit different at this time of day
checking the weather app
and realizing your bedroom
is technically colder
than the North Pole

When you spend forty minutes
scrolling through a streaming app
and finally decide
to just watch a YouTube video
about how something is made
Me explaining the exact lore / of a fictional dystopian society / to a delivery driver / who just wants to hand me / my burrito

POV: you check your retirement fund
and see it dropped three cents
so you immediately start plotting
a life of crime

Things that hit different at this time of day
looking at your fantasy lineup
and realizing your kicker
is outscoring your entire offense

downloading a huge new game pass game
just to let it sit in the library
while you replay your childhood favourite
for the fourth time this year

When you buy one matching lounge set
and immediately start planning
your whole new personality
around going to a juice bar

Things that hit different at this time of day

Getting the fitted sheet
on the mattress correctly
on the very first try
